chunks: Whilst it is no more than a reminder for the people of the world.

key_terms.لِّلْعَالَمِينَ: For the worlds / For all people

ai.seo_question: What is the primary purpose of the Quran according to Surah Al-Qalam?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the Quran's role as a universal moral compass (dhikr) rather than merely a legislative code, aligning with the concept of 'Tanzil' as a reminder for all worlds. It reflects the belief that divine guidance is accessible to all humanity, emphasizing spiritual awakening over rigid legalism, a view supported by the Ahl al-Bayt's interpretation of the Quran's multifaceted meanings.
